name: Classic Margherita Pizza
directions: Preheat oven to 250°C (482°F) with a baking stone if available.
Roll out dough to a 12-inch circle on a floured surface.
Spread tomato sauce evenly over dough, leaving a 1/2-inch border.
Scatter mozzarella cheese over sauce.
Bake on the stone for 10-12 minutes until crust is crisp and cheese melts.
Finish with basil leaves, drizzle with olive oil, and season with salt and optional parmesan.
Slice and serve immediately.
image_description: The image shows a classic Margherita pizza, with a golden-brown crust and a vibrant red tomato sauce. The pizza is topped with fresh mozzarella cheese and garnished with several basil leaves. The pizza appears to be freshly baked, with a slightly charred crust, suggesting a high-temperature oven cooking method. The pizza is presented on a wooden serving board, with a small bowl of red sauce and a bottle of olive oil nearby. The pizza is sliced into eight pieces, with one slice already taken.

name: Chicken Tikka Masala
ingredients: 1 cup heavy cream or coconut cream
directions: Marinate chicken in yogurt, lemon juice, garam masala, cumin, coriander, and a pinch of salt for at least 30 minutes.
In a large pan, heat oil and sauté onion until translucent.
Add garlic and ginger; cook 1 minute until fragrant.
Add marinated chicken; cook until browned on all sides.
Stir in crushed tomatoes and simmer 15 minutes.
Reduce heat and add cream; simmer 5-10 minutes until sauce thickens.
Garnish with cilantro and serve with rice or naan.
image_description: Chicken Tikka Masala in a copper bowl with a creamy, red curry sauce. Chunks of grilled chicken tikka float in the sauce, garnished with fresh cilantro. Served with a side of basmati rice, a naan bread, and small bowls of condiments. The presentation is rustic and hearty, ideal for a cozy meal.

name: Vegetable Stir-Fry with Tofu
directions: Toss tofu with soy sauce and cornstarch.
Heat oil in a wok or large skillet over high heat.
Fry tofu until golden; remove and set aside.
Add garlic and vegetables; stir-fry 3-4 minutes until crisp-tender.
Return tofu to pan; add rice vinegar, hoisin sauce, and sesame oil.
Cook 1-2 minutes until coated; serve with steamed rice.
image_description: A bowl of vegetable stir-fry with tofu is served with a side of white rice. The dish includes broccoli florets, carrots, green beans, and crispy tofu cubes, all tossed in a rich, savory sauce. The vegetables are colorful and appear fresh, arranged neatly in the bowl. The rice is in a separate bowl on the right side.

name: Greek Giouvertsa Salad with Lemon-Oregano Dressing
directions: Toss romaine, cucumber, tomatoes, onion, olives, and feta in a bowl.
Whisk olive oil, lemon juice, oregano, salt, and pepper to make dressing.
Pour dressing over the salad and toss to combine.
Serve immediately.
image_description: A bowl of Greek Giouvertsa Salad filled with chopped lettuce, cherry tomatoes, cucumbers, purple onions, Kalamata olives, and crumbled feta cheese. The salad is topped with a lemon-oregano dressing and served with a lemon wedge and a small bowl of dressing on the side. The salad is presented in a simple, rustic style on a wooden table.

name: Spaghetti Aglio e Olio
directions: Cook spaghetti in salted water until al dente; reserve 1/2 cup pasta water.
Heat olive oil in a pan; add garlic and red pepper flakes, cook until fragrant and lightly golden.
Toss pasta with garlic oil, adding reserve water as needed.
Season, mix in parsley, and serve with parmesan.
image_description: The image shows a bowl of Spaghetti Aglio e Olio. Visible ingredients include pasta, garlic, parsley, and a sprinkle of red chili flakes. name: Distance-Glazed Salmon with Dill
directions: Preheat oven to 200°C (400°F).
Mix honey, soy sauce, mustard, and dill.
Season salmon with salt and pepper; brush with glaze.
Bake 10-12 minutes until flaky; drizzle remaining glaze over and serve.

name: Tomato Basil Soup
directions: Sauté onion and garlic in olive oil until translucent.
Add crushed tomatoes and broth; simmer 15 minutes.
Blend until smooth or leave chunky based on preference.

name: Pad Thai

Mix tamarind paste, fish sauce, and sugar to make sauce.
Sauté garlic in oil; add shrimp or chicken and cook through.
Push meat aside, scramble eggs in the pan, then mix with noodles.
Add sauce and bean sprouts; toss quickly.

directions: Season steaks with salt and pepper.

Pour in the chicken broth and soy sauce; bring to a simmer.
Gently add the tofu cubes and simmer for 5 minutes.
Stir in the cornstarch slurry to thicken the sauce.
Garnish with green onions and serve.
image_description: The image shows a large, deep pan filled with Mapo Tofu. Visible ingredients include cubes of firm tofu, browned ground meat, green onions, and a rich, glossy sauce. The cooking style suggests stir-frying, as evidenced by the browned edges of the tofu and meat. The presentation is rustic, served directly from the pan, which is typical for Mapo Tofu. The portion appears generous, suitable for a hearty meal.

name: Beef and Broccoli
ingredients: 300g flank steak, thinly sliced against the grain
directions: Toss beef slices with cornstarch and a splash of soy sauce; let sit for 10 minutes.
Blanch broccoli in boiling water for 2 minutes, then drain.
Heat oil in a wok and sear beef at high heat until browned; remove.
Stir-fry ginger for 30 seconds, then add broccoli, oyster sauce, and soy sauce.
Return beef to the wok and toss everything together for 1 minute.
Serve immediately.
image_description: The image shows a large round plate filled with a dish of beef and broccoli. Visible ingredients include thinly sliced beef, broccoli florets, cashews, and a soy sauce. The cooking style appears stir-fried, evident from the glistening and slightly browned edges of the beef and broccoli. The dish is presented in a rustic, wooden style plate, with the ingredients neatly arranged. The portion size is generous, suggesting a hearty meal. The dish is accompanied by small bowls of condiments and seasonings.

name: General Tso's Chicken
ingredients: 500g chicken thighs, cut into bite-sized pieces
directions: Coat chicken pieces thoroughly in cornstarch.
Deep fry chicken in hot oil until crispy and golden; drain on paper towels.
In a separate pan, sauté ginger, garlic, and chilies.
Add soy sauce, vinegar, and sugar; simmer until the sugar dissolves.
Toss the crispy chicken into the sauce until fully coated.
Serve over white rice.
image_description: This image shows General Tso's Chicken served with white rice. The dish is presented in a large, round bowl with a crispy fried chicken coated in a sweet and savory sauce. The chicken is garnished with red chili peppers, pine nuts, and slices of garlic. The rice is neatly arranged on the side of the bowl. The presentation is rustic and homestyle, suitable for a hearty meal. The portion size is generous, indicating a serving style meant for sharing or enjoying as a main course.

name: Pork Potstickers (Dumplings)
directions: Mix pork, cabbage, soy sauce, sesame oil, and ginger in a bowl.
Place a teaspoon of filling in the center of a wrapper, moisten edges, and fold/pleat to seal.
Heat oil in a flat skillet and arrange dumplings in a single layer.
Fry for 2 minutes until bottoms are golden.
Pour in water and immediately cover with a lid to steam for 5-7 minutes.
Remove lid and cook until water evaporates and bottoms are crispy again.
image_description: The image displays a collection of pork potstickers, also known as dumplings, arranged in a cast iron skillet. The dumplings have golden brown, crispy tops and are filled with a visible filling. They are garnished with sesame seeds and a drizzle of soy sauce. The cooking style appears to be pan-fried, as indicated by the skillet and the crisp, golden-brown edges of the dumplings. The presentation is rustic and hearty, with the dumplings floating in a pool of sauce. The portion size is ample, suggesting it's a main course or a shared appetizer. The plating style is casual, suitable for a hearty meal.

name: Hot and Sour Soup
directions: Bring broth to a boil in a large pot.
Add tofu, bamboo shoots, soy sauce, and white pepper.
Stir in the cornstarch slurry and simmer until thickened.
Slowly drizzle in the beaten egg while stirring gently to create ribbons.
Stir in the rice vinegar at the very end to preserve the 'sour' punch.
Garnish with green onions.
image_description: The image shows a bowl of Hot and Sour Soup with ingredients labeled around it. Visible ingredients include noodles, tofu, bamboo shoots, sliced green onions, and a poached egg. The soup is garnished with scallions and sprinkled with rice starer. The cooking style appears to be a traditional broth-based soup, and the presentation is a single bowl serving.

name: Chow Mein
directions: Boil noodles according to package instructions, drain, and set aside.
Heat oil in a wok and stir-fry cabbage and carrots for 3 minutes.
Add the noodles to the wok.
Mix soy sauce, oyster sauce, and sugar, then pour over the noodles.
Toss at high heat for 2-3 minutes until noodles are slightly charred and well coated.
Serve hot.
image_description: The image shows a large bowl filled with stir-fried Chow Mein noodles. Visible ingredients include a variety of vegetables such as carrots, broccoli, bell peppers, and green beans, all sliced and mixed with the noodles. The presentation is vibrant with a mix of colors and textures, indicating a well-prepared dish. The bowl is placed on a textured surface, accompanied by small bowls of soy sauce and chili oil, and chopsticks. The portion size is generous, suggesting it's a full serving.

name: Wonton Soup
directions: Bring chicken broth and soy sauce to a boil in a pot.
Add the wontons and simmer for 5 minutes (or until they float).
Add bok choy and cook for 1 minute until wilted.
Turn off heat and stir in sesame oil.
Ladle into bowls and garnish with green onions.
image_description: Visible ingredients and components include three bowls of wonton soup, green onions, ginger, various spices, and a bowl of soy sauce. Cooking style and preparation method are not directly visible, but the ingredients suggest a broth-based soup. Presentation and plating style are minimalist with a wooden chopping board as the base. Portion size is individual bowls for each soup, and serving style is ready to eat.

name: Honey Walnut Shrimp
directions: Dip shrimp in egg, then coat with cornstarch.
Fry shrimp in hot oil until golden and crispy; drain.
In a large bowl, whisk together mayonnaise, honey, and condensed milk.
Toss the warm shrimp and candied walnuts into the sauce until evenly coated.
Serve immediately, usually garnished with steamed broccoli.
image_description: The image showcases a bowl filled with Honey Walnut Shrimp, featuring shrimp coated in a sweet, caramelized honey glaze. Visible ingredients include tender shrimp, crisp broccoli florets, golden walnuts, and drizzles of honey. The cooking style appears to be a stir-fry, indicated by the combination of tender shrimp and lightly sautéed vegetables. The presentation is vibrant and appetizing, with the ingredients arranged in a circular bowl for a cohesive look. The portion size suggests a generous serving, suitable for a main dish.
